verdict.rationale: Concurrency and capacity reservation are fair questions for a local inference runtime, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents reserved or dedicated capacity, parallel request slots, or throughput guarantees under concurrent load. Distributed GPU worker nodes, horizontal scaling and multi-user auth are adjacent scaling and access features, not capacity reservation for steady concurrent throughput.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know the runtime reserves dedicated capacity so throughput holds steady when multiple agents or sessions issue requests concurrently
